changelog:
Initial release of email-notify.

- Sends SMTP email notifications after each Codex task is completed.
- Supports customizable environment variables for SMTP settings and recipients.
- Automatically detects project name from AGENTS.md or project folder.
- Provides a script to send task status, device name, summary, and project info via email.
- Designed for easy integration with Codex and Claude workflows.
summary: Send SMTP email notifications after Codex completes a task. Use when one Codex or Claude run is finished, or when you need to notify on task completion with...
